name: distribution-bar
title: Distribution Bar
description: Proportional stacked strip with in-segment labels and a share legend below.
question: How does the whole split into parts?
whenToUse: One flat categorical breakdown of a total (language mix, task mix, traffic sources) where shares matter more than absolute comparison.
antiUse: Comparing values across multiple groups or over time — use a ranking bar list or time series instead; also avoid with many tiny segments that all fall below the label threshold.
props: segments: { label, value, color? }[] (color falls back to palette by index); unit?: string appended in tooltips
